text:
Most technical founders I know can demo their product to me perfectly — on 𝘵𝘩𝘦𝘪𝘳 laptop, in 𝘵𝘩𝘦𝘪𝘳 environment, with 𝘵𝘩𝘦𝘪𝘳 setup. 😅 And when I asked them to let me try it myself, there are suddenly twelve reasons why "it's not ready yet." 

I'm not sure if this is a universal pattern, but I see it often enough to think it's worth talking about.

𝗠𝘆 𝗶𝗱𝗲𝗮 𝗶𝘀 𝘁𝗵𝗶𝘀: 𝗶𝗳 𝘆𝗼𝘂 𝗰𝗮𝗻𝗻𝗼𝘁 𝘀𝗵𝗼𝘄 𝗶𝘁, 𝘆𝗼𝘂 𝗮𝗿𝗲 𝗽𝗿𝗼𝗯𝗮𝗯𝗹𝘆 𝗻𝗼𝘁 𝗯𝘂𝗶𝗹𝗱𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗮 𝗽𝗿𝗼𝗱𝘂𝗰𝘁 𝘆𝗲𝘁 — 𝘆𝗼𝘂 𝗮𝗿𝗲 𝗷𝘂𝘀𝘁 𝘄𝗿𝗶𝘁𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝘀𝗼𝗺𝗲𝘁𝗵𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗶𝗻 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗿𝗲𝗽𝗼𝘀𝗶𝘁𝗼𝗿𝘆. And three months can quietly disappear that way, without anyone outside ever actually touching what you built. 💡

Maybe the more useful question to ask early — before "𝘩𝘰𝘸 𝘥𝘰 𝘸𝘦 𝘮𝘢𝘬𝘦 𝘪𝘵 𝘣𝘦𝘵𝘵𝘦𝘳" — is just: "𝗵𝗼𝘄 𝘄𝗶𝗹𝗹 𝘄𝗲 𝘀𝗵𝗼𝘄 𝘁𝗵𝗶𝘀 𝘁𝗼 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝘄𝗼𝗿𝗹𝗱?"
